import os
import requests
import urllib.parse

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"

def handle_google_oauth_callback(authorization_code: str):
    if not GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or not GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET or not GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI:
        raise ValueError("Google client credentials and redirect URI must be set in environment variables.")

    data = {
        "code": authorization_code,
        "client_id": GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
        "redirect_uri": GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI,
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
    }
    
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
    response = requests.post(GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL, data=data, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

import requests

GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL = "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo"

def fetch_google_profile_claims(access_token: str):
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
    response = requests.get(GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    claims = response.json()
    return normalize_google_claims(claims)

def normalize_google_claims(claims: dict):
    # Basic normalization for Google claims
    normalized_claims = {
        "sub": claims.get("sub"),
        "email": claims.get("email"),
        "email_verified": claims.get("email_verified"),
        "name": claims.get("name"),
        "given_name": claims.get("given_name"),
        "family_name": claims.get("family_name"),
        "picture": claims.get("picture"),
        "locale": claims.get("locale"),
    }
    return normalized_claims

import os
import base64
import hashlib
import urllib.parse

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
GOOGLE_AUTHORIZATION_BASE_URL = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"

def generate_pkce_codes():
    code_verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(32)).rstrip(b'=').decode('utf-8')
    code_challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode('utf-8')).digest()).rstrip(b'=').decode('utf-8')
    return code_verifier, code_challenge

def start_google_pkce_login(code_challenge: str):
    if not GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or not GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI:
        raise ValueError("Google client ID and redirect URI must be set in environment variables.")

    params = {
        "client_id": GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
        "redirect_uri": GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI,
        "response_type": "code",
        "scope": "openid email profile",
        "access_type": "offline",
        "prompt": "consent",
        "code_challenge": code_challenge,
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    }
    return f"{GOOGLE_AUTHORIZATION_BASE_URL}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"

def exchange_pkce_code_for_tokens(authorization_code: str, code_verifier: str):
    import requests # Imported locally to avoid circular dependencies if this was a shared helper

    if not GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or not GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI:
        raise ValueError("Google client ID and redirect URI must be set in environment variables.")

    data = {
        "code": authorization_code,
        "client_id": GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
        "redirect_uri": GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI,
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "code_verifier": code_verifier,
    }
    
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
    response = requests.post(GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL, data=data, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

import os

class GoogleOauthClientConfig:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
        self.client_secret = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.redirect_uri = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
        self.authorization_base_url = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
        self.token_url = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
        self.userinfo_url = "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo"
        self.scopes = "openid email profile"

    def validate(self):
        if not self.client_id or not self.redirect_uri:
            raise ValueError("Google client ID and redirect URI must be set.")
        # Client secret is not always required for public clients (PKCE flow)
        # if not self.client_secret:
        #     raise ValueError("Google client secret must be set.")


def get_google_oauth_config():
    config = GoogleOauthClientConfig()
    config.validate()
    return config

from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

class OAuthTokenResponse:
    def __init__(self, data: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.access_token = data.get("access_token")
        self.expires_in = data.get("expires_in")
        self.scope = data.get("scope")
        self.token_type = data.get("token_type")
        self.id_token = data.get("id_token")
        self.refresh_token = data.get("refresh_token")

class UserProfileClaims:
    def __init__(self, raw_claims: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.sub: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("sub")
        self.email: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("email")
        self.email_verified: Optional[bool] = raw_claims.get("email_verified")
        self.name: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("name")
        self.given_name: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("given_name")
        self.family_name: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("family_name")
        self.picture: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("picture")
        self.locale: Optional[str] = raw_claims.get("locale")
        self._raw_claims = raw_claims

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "sub": self.sub,
            "email": self.email,
            "email_verified": self.email_verified,
            "name": self.name,
            "given_name": self.given_name,
            "family_name": self.family_name,
            "picture": self.picture,
            "locale": self.locale,
        }

def normalize_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> UserProfileClaims:
    return UserProfileClaims(claims)

import boto3
import os
import datetime
import uuid

AWS_REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")
AUDIT_TABLE_NAME = os.environ.get("AUDIT_TABLE_NAME", "FederatedLoginAudit")

def persist_audit_record(record: dict) -> dict:
    dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb", region_name=AWS_REGION)
    table = dynamodb.Table(AUDIT_TABLE_NAME)

    # Add audit-specific fields
    record["auditId"] = str(uuid.uuid4())
    record["timestamp"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"

    try:
        response = table.put_item(Item=record)
        return {"status": "success", "auditId": record["auditId"], "dynamodb_response": response}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}
